name: Sellercloud
description: Sellercloud multichannel e-commerce operations: sales orders with notes and packages, saved order views, product catalog and prices, inventory per warehouse, customers, companies, purchase orders, vendors and their products, returns (RMAs), warehouses, transfers, picklists and queued jobs. Read-only, signs in with a Sellercloud employee login.
prerequisites: A Sellercloud account, the REST API endpoint of your Sellercloud server (from https://api.sellercloud.com/api/server-by-team/?team=<team name>), and the username and password of a Sellercloud employee with the permissions for the data to read.
instructions:
## Sellercloud
Sellercloud is the US e-commerce operations platform for multichannel sellers: orders from Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Shopify and other channels, the product catalog, inventory across warehouses, purchasing from vendors, returns (RMAs) and warehouse work. This connector uses the Sellercloud REST API and is read-only.

## Setup
1. `SELLERCLOUD_API_URL`: the REST API endpoint of your Sellercloud server. Open `https://api.sellercloud.com/api/server-by-team/?team=<your team name>` in a browser (the team name is the one you sign in to Sellercloud with) and copy the `RestApiEndpoint` value, e.g. `https://xx.api.sellercloud.com/rest` or `https://xxxxxxx.api.sellercloud.us/rest`, without a trailing slash.
2. `SELLERCLOUD_USERNAME` and `SELLERCLOUD_PASSWORD`: a Sellercloud employee (user) login. Sellercloud recommends a separate employee for each integration; give it the Delta permissions for the data the AI should read (orders, products, inventory, purchasing, customers).

The connector signs in with `POST /api/token` and sends the returned `access_token` as `Authorization: Bearer` on every call. A token lasts 30 to 60 minutes; the connector signs in again by itself before it expires and after a 401.

## Start here
- Orders: `sellercloud_list_orders` with `order_status=[2]` (InProcess) and `shipping_status=1` (Unshipped) for open orders, or `created_range=1` for today's orders; then `sellercloud_get_order`, `sellercloud_get_order_notes` and `sellercloud_list_order_packages` for tracking.
- Saved views: `sellercloud_list_order_views` and `sellercloud_list_orders_by_view` return exactly what a view in Sellercloud shows.
- Stock: `sellercloud_get_inventory` for one SKU, `sellercloud_get_inventory_by_warehouse` for its quantity per warehouse, `sellercloud_list_inventory` with `physical_qty_to=0` for products out of stock.
- Purchasing: `sellercloud_list_purchase_orders` with `statuses=[1]` (Ordered) and `received_statuses=[0,1]`, then `sellercloud_get_purchase_order_items`.
- Returns: `sellercloud_list_rmas` with `statuses=[0]`, then `sellercloud_get_rma_items`.

## Ids, statuses, dates
Orders, purchase orders, RMAs, customers, vendors, companies and warehouses have integer ids; products are identified by their product id (SKU) string. Statuses and channels are integer codes listed in each parameter (e.g. order status 1 ShoppingCart, 2 InProcess, 3 Completed, 100 ProblemOrder, 200 OnHold, 300 Quote, 999 Void, -1 Cancelled); answers carry the same codes. The full enumerations are under Resources in the Sellercloud API docs. Dates are sent as `MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM`. Amounts of international orders are converted to USD when the order is created; see CurrencyRateFromUSD in the order.

## Pages
Lists return `Items` (or `Results`) and `TotalResults`. `page_size` is 10 by default and at most 50; raise `page_number` for the next page.

## Limits
10,800 requests per hour per user and IP address. Over the limit Sellercloud answers "Too many requests." with a `RateLimitResetTime`; wait until then.

## Writes
None. Creating or updating orders, products, inventory, purchase orders and RMAs is not part of this connector.

SELLERCLOUD_API_URL.label: REST API endpoint
SELLERCLOUD_API_URL.help: Open https://api.sellercloud.com/api/server-by-team/?team=<your team name> and copy the RestApiEndpoint value, ending in /rest, without a trailing slash.
SELLERCLOUD_API_URL.patternMessage: The RestApiEndpoint of your server, e.g. https://xx.api.sellercloud.com/rest, without a trailing slash.

SELLERCLOUD_USERNAME.label: Username
SELLERCLOUD_USERNAME.help: Username (usually the e-mail address) of the Sellercloud employee the connector signs in as. Prefer a dedicated employee for this integration.

verifyHints.400: Sellercloud refused the sign-in. Check the username and password, and that the API URL is the RestApiEndpoint of your own server.
verifyHints.401: Sellercloud rejected the sign-in or the token. Check the username, password and API URL.
verifyHints.403: The Sellercloud employee lacks the permission for this data. Grant the matching Delta permissions to that employee.
verifyHints.404: No Sellercloud REST API at this address. Copy the RestApiEndpoint from https://api.sellercloud.com/api/server-by-team/?team=<team name>; it ends in /rest.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Sellercloud allows 10,800 requests per hour per user and IP address. Wait until the RateLimitResetTime in the answer and try again.

tools.name: sellercloud_list_orders
tools.description: Search sales orders with filters: status, payment and shipping status, company, channel, SKU, customer, warehouse, channel order id, tracking number, keyword, creation or update dates. Returns Items (status, dates, customer, totals, carrier, tracking and order lines) and TotalResults, up to 50 per page. Each row is cut to the fields an agent needs (Sellercloud returns about 70 per order and 200 per line, addresses and payments included); call sellercloud_get_order for every field of one record.

order_status.description: Order status codes: 1 ShoppingCart, 2 InProcess, 3 Completed, 100 ProblemOrder, 200 OnHold, 300 Quote, 999 Void, -1 Cancelled.

payment_status.description: Payment status codes: 10 NoPayment, 11 NoPayment or partial, 20 Authorized, 30 Charged, 40 Uncleared, 50 PartialRefund, 60 FullRefund, 61 Partial or full refund, 70 PartiallyPaid, 71 Charged or partial refund, 99 PaymentError, 711 Charged or partially paid, 713 Charged or authorized.

shipping_status.description: Shipping status: 0 Unknown, 1 Unshipped, 2 PartiallyShipped, 3 FullyShipped, 4 ReadyForPickup.

channels.description: Channel (order source) ids, e.g. 0 Local_Store, 1 eBay, 4 Amazon, 6 Website, 20 FBA, 21 Wholesale, 24 Etsy, 42 Walmart. Full list: https://developer.sellercloud.com/dev-article/channels/

channel_order_ids.description: Order ids as the channel knows them (e.g. Amazon order numbers).

warehouse_ids.description: Warehouse ids the order items ship from.

sku.description: Only orders that contain this product id (SKU).

tracking_number.description: Only the order with this package tracking number.

keyword.description: Global search term, as in the Sellercloud search box (order id, customer name, e-mail and more).

created_from.description: Created on or after. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

created_to.description: Created on or before. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

updated_from.description: Last updated on or after. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

updated_to.description: Last updated on or before. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

created_range.description: Order date range. Preset range instead of from/to dates: 1 Today, 20 Yesterday, 2 This week, 3 Last week, 10 Last 7 days, 4 Last 31 days, 32 This month, 22 Last month, 28 Month to date, 21 Last 90 days, 7 This calendar year, 23 Last 12 months, 9 All dates.

order_by.description: Sort field: 0 OrderID, 1 OrderDate, 2 OrderStatus, 3 ShipDate, 4 ShippingStatus.

ascending.description: true for ascending order, false for newest or highest first.

page_size.description: Results per page, 1 to 50 (Sellercloud default 10, maximum 50).

tools.name: sellercloud_get_order
tools.description: Get one sales order by Sellercloud order id: details, statuses, items with quantities and prices, totals, shipping details and packages, shipping and billing address, payments, profit and loss, related orders and custom columns.

tools.name: sellercloud_get_order_notes
tools.description: Get the notes of one sales order: note text, category, author, date and whether the note is pinned.

tools.name: sellercloud_list_order_packages
tools.description: List the shipped packages of one sales order: tracking number and link, weight and dimensions, shipping cost, estimated and actual delivery date, delivery status and the items in each package.

tools.name: sellercloud_list_order_views
tools.description: List the saved order views (filters saved in the Sellercloud Manage Orders page) with id and name, to use with sellercloud_list_orders_by_view.

tools.name: sellercloud_list_orders_by_view
tools.description: List the sales orders that match a saved order view, exactly as the view filters them in Sellercloud. Returns Items and TotalResults, up to 50 per page.

tools.name: sellercloud_list_products
tools.description: Search the product catalog by SKU, UPC, keyword, company, vendor, vendor SKU, brand, warehouse, physical quantity, active status, kit or shadow type, creation or update date. Returns product data with names, identifiers, prices, average cost, quantities and units sold, up to 50 per page. Each row is cut to the fields an agent needs (Sellercloud returns about 200 per product).

sku.description: Product id (SKU); several separated by commas.

keyword.description: Global search term, as in the Sellercloud catalog search box.

company_ids.description: Company ids the products belong to.

vendor_ids.description: Vendor ids the products are linked to.

vendor_skus.description: Vendor SKUs (the vendor's own part numbers).

warehouse_ids.description: Warehouse ids that hold the products.

kits.description: Kit filter: 0 not a kit parent or component, 1 kit parent, 2 kit component, 3 not a kit parent, 4 not a kit component.

shadows.description: Shadow filter: 0 non-shadows only, 1 shadows only, 2 shadow parents, 3 not a shadow or shadow parent.

created_from.description: Created on or after. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

created_to.description: Created on or before. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

updated_from.description: Last updated on or after. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

updated_to.description: Last updated on or before. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

page_size.description: Results per page, 1 to 50 (Sellercloud default 10, maximum 50).

tools.name: sellercloud_get_product_prices
tools.description: Get the prices of one product by SKU: site price, stop-loss price and the price set for each sales channel.

product_id.description: Product id (SKU), exactly as in Sellercloud.

tools.name: sellercloud_list_inventory
tools.description: Search inventory by SKU, EAN, UPC, keyword, company, vendor, brand, warehouse, physical quantity or update date. Returns per product the physical, reserved and aggregate quantities, per-warehouse stock, average cost and units sold in the last 15 to 365 days, up to 50 per page. Each row is cut to the fields an agent needs (Sellercloud returns 70 to 200 per row); call sellercloud_get_inventory for every field of one record.

sku.description: Product id (SKU); several separated by commas.

ean.description: EAN barcode; several separated by commas.

keyword.description: Global search term, as in the Sellercloud inventory search box.

company_ids.description: Company ids the products belong to.

vendor_ids.description: Vendor ids the products are linked to.

physical_qty_from.description: Minimum physical quantity on hand, e.g. 1 to skip products out of stock.

physical_qty_to.description: Maximum physical quantity on hand, e.g. 0 for products out of stock.

updated_from.description: Last updated on or after. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

updated_to.description: Last updated on or before. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

page_size.description: Results per page, 1 to 50 (Sellercloud default 10, maximum 50).

tools.name: sellercloud_get_inventory
tools.description: Get the full inventory record of one product by SKU: general data, identifiers (UPC, EAN, ASIN), sales metrics, inventory quantities, pricing, kit components, images and custom columns.

product_id.description: Product id (SKU), exactly as in Sellercloud.

tools.name: sellercloud_get_inventory_by_warehouse
tools.description: Get the stock of one product per warehouse: physical and available quantity in each warehouse, or in one warehouse only when warehouse_id is given.

product_id.description: Product id (SKU), exactly as in Sellercloud.

tools.name: sellercloud_list_customers
tools.description: Search customers by e-mail, name, business name, phone, city, ZIP code, type, channel, company, keyword or creation and change dates. Returns customer records, up to 50 per page.

channel.description: Channel the customer came from, e.g. 0 Local_Store, 1 eBay, 4 Amazon, 6 Website, 42 Walmart.

company_ids.description: Company ids the customers belong to.

keyword.description: Global search term, as in the Sellercloud customer search box.

created_from.description: Created on or after. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

created_to.description: Created on or before. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

modified_from.description: Modified on or after. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

modified_to.description: Modified on or before. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

page_size.description: Results per page, 1 to 50 (Sellercloud default 10, maximum 50).

tools.name: sellercloud_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by Sellercloud customer id: general and personal data, addresses, order and wholesale options, customer groups and custom columns.

tools.name: sellercloud_list_companies
tools.description: List the companies (business units or stores) of the Sellercloud account with id, name, default and disabled flags and enabled channels. Company ids filter most other tools.

keyword.description: Search term for the company name.

page_size.description: Results per page, 1 to 50 (Sellercloud default 10, maximum 50).

tools.name: sellercloud_list_purchase_orders
tools.description: Search purchase orders by id, company, status, receiving warehouse, shipping and receiving status, keyword or created, received and updated dates. Returns PO headers with vendor, totals and statuses, up to 50 per page.

company_ids.description: Company ids the purchase orders belong to.

statuses.description: PO status: 0 Saved, 1 Ordered, 2 Pending, 3 Received, 4 Cancelled, 5 Completed.

shipping_statuses.description: Vendor shipping status: 0 None, 1 PartiallyShipped, 2 FullyShipped.

keyword.description: Global search term, as in the Sellercloud purchase order search box.

created_from.description: Created on or after. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

created_to.description: Created on or before. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

received_from.description: Received on or after. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

received_to.description: Received on or before. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

updated_from.description: Updated on or after. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

updated_to.description: Updated on or before. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

page_size.description: Results per page, 1 to 50 (Sellercloud default 10, maximum 50).

tools.name: sellercloud_get_purchase_order
tools.description: Get one purchase order by id: purchase details, vendor and invoice, items, totals, statuses, related items and custom columns.

tools.name: sellercloud_get_purchase_order_items
tools.description: Get the line items of one purchase order: product, vendor SKU, quantities ordered and received, unit cost and line totals.

tools.name: sellercloud_list_vendors
tools.description: List vendors (suppliers) with id, name, e-mail and whether default; filter by vendor ids, names, e-mail or active status. Up to 50 per page.

page_size.description: Results per page, 1 to 50 (Sellercloud default 10, maximum 50).

tools.name: sellercloud_get_vendor
tools.description: Get one vendor by id: name, alias, account number, e-mail and CC address, website, and whether active and default.

tools.name: sellercloud_list_vendor_products
tools.description: List the products a vendor supplies: Sellercloud SKU, vendor SKU, product name, vendor price, price and quantity per case, quantity and availability. Up to 50 per page.

page_size.description: Results per page, 1 to 50 (Sellercloud default 10, maximum 50).

tools.name: sellercloud_list_rmas
tools.description: Search returns (RMAs) by RMA or order id, company, product, status, channel, channel order or RMA id, tracking number, or created, received, closed and updated dates. Up to 50 per page.

order_ids.description: Sellercloud order ids the returns belong to.

company_ids.description: Company ids the returns belong to.

statuses.description: RMA status: 0 Open, 1 On_Hold, 2 Processing, 3 Closed.

channels.description: Channel ids of the original orders, e.g. 1 eBay, 4 Amazon, 6 Website, 42 Walmart.

channel_order_ids.description: Order ids as the channel knows them.

channel_rma_id.description: Return id as the channel knows it.

created_from.description: RMA created on or after. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

created_to.description: RMA created on or before. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

received_from.description: Items received on or after. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

received_to.description: Items received on or before. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

closed_from.description: Closed on or after. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

closed_to.description: Closed on or before. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

updated_from.description: Last updated on or after. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

updated_to.description: Last updated on or before. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

page_size.description: Results per page, 1 to 50 (Sellercloud default 10, maximum 50).

tools.name: sellercloud_get_rma
tools.description: Get one return (RMA) by id: customer, company, original order and total, status and approval, replacement order, tracking number, credit memo, items and change history.

tools.name: sellercloud_get_rma_items
tools.description: Get the items of one return (RMA): SKU, quantities ordered, returned and received, return reason, resolution, refund amount, problem description, approval status and serial numbers.

tools.name: sellercloud_list_warehouses
tools.description: List warehouses with id, name, type (normal, FBA, dropship, WFS and others), address, whether default and sellable; filter by ids, name, type, default or sellable. Up to 50 per page.

warehouse_type.description: 0 Normal, 1 FBA, 2 Un_Tested, 3 Interim, 4 DropShip, 5 NewEgg, 6 Cdiscount, 7 WFS, 8 AWD.

is_default.description: 0 all, 1 default warehouse only, 2 non-default only.

is_sellable.description: 0 all, 1 sellable warehouses only, 2 non-sellable only.

page_size.description: Results per page, 1 to 50 (Sellercloud default 10, maximum 50).

tools.name: sellercloud_list_warehouse_transfers
tools.description: List warehouse inventory transfers (WITR) between warehouses with status, company, source, interim and destination warehouse; filter by ids, status, warehouses or company. Up to 50 per page.

statuses.description: Transfer status: 0 Pending, 1 Requested, 2 Shipped, 3 Received, 10 PartiallyPicked, 15 FullyPicked, 20 PartiallyReceived, 88 Rejected, 99 Cancelled.

page_size.description: Results per page, 1 to 50 (Sellercloud default 10, maximum 50).

tools.name: sellercloud_list_picklists
tools.description: List picklists with id, title, warehouse, status and generation date; filter by ids, title, product, order, warehouse, status or generation date. Up to 50 per page.

sku.description: Only picklists that contain this product id (SKU).

order_id.description: Only picklists that contain this Sellercloud order id.

generated_from.description: Generated on or after. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

generated_to.description: Generated on or before. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

page_size.description: Results per page, 1 to 50 (Sellercloud default 10, maximum 50).

tools.name: sellercloud_list_queued_jobs
tools.description: List queued jobs (imports, exports, bulk updates) with type, status, priority, submitter and dates; filter by job id, status, company or submission date. Up to 50 per page.

statuses.description: Job status: 0 Submitted, 1 Processing, 3 Completed, 4 Failed, 5 PartialSuccess, 6 OnHold, 7 Cancelled, 8 Cancelled (service restarted), 9 Aborted (too much time), 10 Cancelled while running.

submitted_from.description: Submitted on or after. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

submitted_to.description: Submitted on or before. Date and time in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM, e.g. 10/01/2026 00:00.

page_size.description: Results per page, 1 to 50 (Sellercloud default 10, maximum 50).

tools.name: sellercloud_get_queued_job
tools.description: Get one queued job by id: type, status and submitter, phase and record progress, succeeded and failed counts, input and output file. Use it to check whether an import or export has finished.

tools.name: sellercloud_list_brands
tools.description: List the brands defined in Sellercloud with id and name, to resolve brand ids in products or to filter products and inventory by brand.

tools.name: sellercloud_list_manufacturers
tools.description: List the manufacturers defined for one company with id and name, to resolve manufacturer ids in product data.
